verdict.line: You lose if you walk Q (Last Rites) or E (Mourning Mist) engages into an up Blinding Dart and get poked down by Toxic Shot before level 6; you win if you trap him inside W (Dark Procession) with an E mark live and force the duel before his Noxious Trap mushrooms start zoning.

brief.thesis: Yorick has no gap closer against a ranged kiter, so the entire lane is decided by whether you can use W (Dark Procession) to physically wall off Teemo's retreat before he can land Blinding Dart to blind your empowered auto. Measured data gives Yorick the lane and solo-kill edge, but the 47.5% head-to-head over 1,070 games shows Teemo's Toxic Shot poke and Noxious Trap zoning claw the advantage back if you trade on his terms instead of yours.

theirWindow.when: Blinding Dart (Q) is up, you're alone
theirWindow.what: He will poke-trade freely knowing he can blind your empowered Last Rites auto to deny the heal; don't initiate, just farm with Mist Walkers and let Toxic Shot chip you instead of trading autos.

yourWindow.when: W wall lands behind him, E mark is live
yourWindow.what: Dark Procession cuts his kiting path and Mourning Mist's armor shred plus slow lets your Walkers and empowered Q actually stick; commit the all-in here, not before.

start.why: 71.6% pick rate at 47.8% WR; the sustain and passive block directly offsets Toxic Shot's poison DoT chipping you in every exchange.

boots.why: 60.2% pick, 50.8% WR; tenacity and magic resist blunt both the Toxic Shot stacking damage and any slow from a landed mushroom.

core.why: Part of the highest-measured core (58.1% WR over 43 games); the burst and move speed let you close distance the moment W traps him.
Common second item across all listed cores; cooldown reduction keeps W and E available to reset the trap on a kiting Teemo.
Caps the top-performing path; armor pen plus slow-on-hit keeps him from simply walking out of Dark Procession range.

he's taking Ignite and chunking you low before you can close in

runes.keystoneWhy: The 53.4% WR Precision page's sustained healing offsets Toxic Shot poke across a long poke-lane, and the adaptive force stacking rewards the extended trades you're forcing after a W wall. Master-tier Yorick players instead run Grasp of the Undying from the Resolve tree across 6,005 games for the same poke-sustain logic — better if you expect a passive farm lane rather than committing to dueling.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite (48.5% WR) presses the solo-kill advantage the data gives you before Teemo can heal or kite out of a trapped W; Flash+Teleport (59.3% pick) is the safer scaling choice if you're planning to split-push with Maiden later instead of forcing early kills.

playing.title: Don't trade into an up Blinding Dart
playing.detail: If his Q (8s cooldown) is available, holding your empowered Last Rites auto for it gets blinded and wastes the heal; wait it out and farm with Mist Walkers instead.

playing.title: Wall first, mark second
playing.detail: Land W (Dark Procession) to cut his retreat path before throwing E (Mourning Mist); E's slow alone isn't enough to catch a kiting target with Move Quick active.

playing.title: Respect his passive reset
playing.detail: If Teemo stands still and vanishes via Camouflage, back off contested bushes near your wall — he returns with Element of Surprise attack speed and can punish a lingering engage.

playing.title: Force the fight before level 6
playing.detail: Noxious Trap (R) only comes online at 6; your highest solo-kill window is before he can zone skirmishes with mushrooms.

playing.title: Buy Mercury's Treads on the first boots trip
playing.detail: Toxic Shot stacks on every auto he lands; tenacity and magic resist blunt the chip damage that otherwise wins his lane for free.

playing.title: Siege with Maiden, not solo
playing.detail: Once R (Eulogy of the Isles) is up, use Maiden's bonus damage and raised Walkers to pressure towers — Teemo has no frontline tool to contest a siege alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning tying them to Yorick's and Teemo's actual ability behavior is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Teemo’s (Q) makes it difficult to close in to deal damage. Use [E] and [P] to contest land while trapping him inside [W] when his health is low to kill him. Avoid being punished during early game as he will try to kill you using Ignite.
